params.name: contextId
params.description: The numeric ID of the context for which the filter should be added.

params.name: ruleId
params.description: The numeric ID of the rule for which the filter should apply.

params.name: newLevel
params.description: The numeric risk representation ('0 - Informational' through '3 - High') ['-1 - False Positive'].

params.name: url
params.description: The URL for which the filter should apply (can be regex).

params.name: urlIsRegex
params.description: A boolean indicating whether or not the URL is a regex.

params.name: parameter
params.description: The parameter name for which the filter should apply (can be regex).

params.name: enabled
params.description: A boolean indicating whether or not the filter should be enabled.

params.name: parameterIsRegex
params.description: A boolean indicating whether or not the parameter name is a regex.

params.name: attack
params.description: The attack value for which the filter should apply (can be regex).

params.name: attackIsRegex
params.description: A boolean indicating whether or not the attack value is a regex.

params.name: evidence
params.description: The evidence value for which the filter should apply (can be regex).

params.name: evidenceIsRegex
params.description: A boolean indicating whether or not the evidence value is a regex.

params.name: methods
params.description: The HTTP methods (comma separated) for which the filter should apply.
